default:
Torrent Client App is a free, open-source BitTorrent client and torrent downloader for Windows 10 and 11. Click a magnet link in your browser or double-click a .torrent file, and the download starts. No ads, no account, no bundled offers.

Download and seed
• Open magnet links from your browser and .torrent files from File Explorer.
• See progress, download and upload speed, seeds, peers and time remaining.
• Start, pause, stop and remove transfers one at a time or all at once.
• Transfers that were running resume automatically after a restart.

Stay in control
• Wi-Fi-only mode keeps transfers off mobile broadband and resumes them when you reconnect.
• Global and per-torrent download and upload limits.
• Limit active downloads and seeds, with seeding ratio and time limits.
• Choose where downloads are saved.

Privacy
No advertising or analytics SDKs. As with any BitTorrent app, trackers and peers can see your IP address; route supported traffic through your own SOCKS5 proxy if you prefer.

More
• Send finished audiobook downloads to LibroNest.
• System, light and dark themes, and 24 interface languages.
• Native x64 and ARM64 builds, including Snapdragon-powered Surface Pro and Surface Laptop.

Transfers run while the app is open and the PC is awake. Download and share only content you have the right to use.
